Hymn 152: God Be with You Till We Meet Again
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: William G. Tomer

This is hymn number 152 titled "God Be with You Till We Meet Again" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William G. Tomer and the lyrics were written by Jeremiah E. Rankin.
